name: user-form
description: A form to create or edit a user, in three presentations: a whole page (variant page), a compact form for a Dialog (modal) and a single-column form for a Sheet (sheet). Fields: profile picture, name, job title, email, phone with a calling-code select, address, time zone, language, bio, role, active switch and team, chosen with a plain fields object. Edit mode adds a danger zone to suspend or reinstate and delete, each behind a confirmation. Save stays disabled until something changes, and Cancel asks before throwing changes away. Your onSubmit does the work. UI permission is not security: the server must check again.
